name: Danganronpa SE: Twilight of Ceres
summary:
Danganronpa SE: Twilight of Ceres is a nonprofit Danganronpa fangame made in RPG Maker MV3D. The game currently only has a playable prologue.

Being based on Danganronpa, the plot follows a similar formula. Sixteen students find themselves trapped in Ceres Academy by an eccentric headmaster, with only one way out.

The plot follows Mari Aitoji, the Ultimate Journalist who has been scouted by Ceres Academy to attend their prestigious school. In a world that revolves around the Ultimate system, who could deny such an opportunity?
